rationale: Ubisoft explicitly frames all transactions as revocable licenses with no ownership rights, yet uses casual 'buy/purchase' language that obscures this reality for casual readers. The document combines relatively clear non-ownership terms with aggressive unilateral termination (without notice), mandatory arbitration, class-action waivers, and broad content ownership claims that strongly disadvantage consumers.

You have no property rights in any achievements, virtual items and/or virtual currency
